recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. The current core workflow source now matches the applied WG decision; any future cleanup of external Confluence example anchors or unused diagram assets can be handled separately if the work group wants to maintain those external materials.
issue_request: FHIR-46220 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core workflow, raised in R5 and applied for R6, asking to drop the original Option I because it predated current subscription and notification support and no longer made sense.
initial_application: PR #3363 from branch vassil-FHIR-46220, merged by e60ef21397, included source commit d6445217a9 that removed the old POST/sub-Task Option I and renumbered later workflow management options. The source commit subject incorrectly used FHIR-46330, but that Jira is unrelated; the PR branch, merge, Jira comment, and Confluence minutes tie the work to FHIR-46220. In the current branch, workflow-communications.html already had the renumbered I/J/K list while workflow-management.html had regressed to include the removed section and stale later headings.
additional_context: The workflow pages are active narrative linked from source/workflow-module.html, and exchanging-messaging.html is active exchange narrative linked from source/exchanging.html. Confluence minutes from 2024-06-24 support the FHIR-46220 workflow update. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community rationale; the only relevant older Option I Zulip thread noted little known implementation experience.
reconciliation: Deleted the obsolete POST/sub-Task Option I section from source/workflow-management.html, removed its local example scenario from source/workflow-examples.html, renumbered the remaining workflow-management anchors/headings to match the current communications list, and updated source/exchanging-messaging.html so its workflow link targets the retained messaging option.

source/exchanging-messaging.html: changed the messaging-driven workflow cross-link from workflow-management.html#optionj to #optioni so it points to the retained messaging option after renumbering.
